label: Notification Stack
description: App notifications that land as real ones: a filled app tile with a drawn glyph (never an emoji), title, time and body on a card with a soft layered shadow. In a corner they slide in as a stack; placed by geometry (fill) a card lands with weight -- tipped back in depth, settling flat -- when its box appears.

icon.label: Icon: a house glyph name (mail, inbox, bell, flame, target, eye, check, x, doc, megaphone, trash, question, tag, users, user, clock, send, book, dollar, repeat, calendar, building, chart, info, alert, share, chat, star, phone, link, search, zap). An emoji maps to the nearest glyph. Omit for the type's own glyph.

fill.label: The cards fill the placed box (no corner inset) and land in depth

hold.label: Keep the cards up to the cut instead of leaving before the scene ends

surface.label: 'solid' = white card for a person or a light plate (default: glass for dark screens)

at.label: Scene seconds the cards arrive (default: when the box enters)
